body: WHERE FORGE ENDS AND MCM BEGINS. Forge is the operating system: protocols, agent comms, identity, standards enforcement. MCM is the product: Algebra II study tool for one specific student. Forge design tokens are dark github-style: fd-text-1 #E6EDF3, fd-card #161b22. MCM uses Detroit Pistons: #C8102E #1D42BA #002D62 #BEC0C2. These are different design languages. Forge-derived components (FD SVG chart, dad-banner) belong in MCM only if they survive the Direct-Detroit-Earned test. The SVG chart passes: dark, data-forward, earned-green at 93%. The fd-* token migration is pending FD approval. MCM design decisions I make independently: voice copy, spacing for ADHD, color semantics for Kai. Forge design decisions FD makes: token values, chart architecture, component patterns. The line: if it affects Kai directly it is MCM territory. If it is infrastructure it is Forge territory.
